resources.string: Ubuntu sessions provide a full Linux dev environment (apt / bash / toolchains); the rootfs ships inside the APK (full Ubuntu, ~300MB+ archive). First offline unpack takes ~2–5 minutes, with progress shown in the banner.

Full Linux environment: gcc / python3 / git / vim / man out of the box (offline unpack built in, ~2–5 minutes)

Vibrate when the shell rings BEL (failed completion, Ctrl+G, command errors).
No screen timeout while reading long task output (builds / apt / logs).
When the whitelist is non-empty, only its commands are allowed; blacklisted commands are always denied. Matched by the first segment of the command (e.g. rm / adb).
Environment unpacking and management (built-in Ubuntu / toolchain deps) lives in the environment center behind the layers icon in the top bar.

The environment ships inside the APK (full Ubuntu, rootfs archive ~300MB+) — first offline unpack takes ~2–5 minutes (~1GB storage after extraction, progress shown live). Unpacking and removal are both reversible; user data (/root, workspace) is preserved.
The device’s built-in command-line environment (mksh / toybox: ls, grep, am, pm, …). No download needed, available anytime; does not include the full apt / bash toolchain.

This removes the unpacked rootfs (~1GB+) and the unpack cache, freeing storage. The built-in archive stays inside the APK and can be unpacked offline again anytime; user data (guest /root and workspace) is preserved. All running Ubuntu sessions must be closed first.

Full Linux dev environment (apt / bash / python / build toolchains) running via PRoot without root. The official rootfs ships inside the APK (SHA-256 verified at build time); first use unpacks offline. apt bootstrap needs network and auto-degrades when offline.
apt bootstrap incomplete (%1$s) — the environment is usable, but apt operations will fail with real errors until the network returns and it is repaired.
